description: NIST CAVP KBKDF (SP 800-108) counter-mode response file KDFCTR_gen.rsp, stored verbatim from the archive member
layout_notes: Sections are keyed by [PRF=], [CTRLOCATION=BEFORE_FIXED|AFTER_FIXED|MIDDLE_FIXED] and [RLEN=8|16|24|32_BITS]. BEFORE_FIXED/AFTER_FIXED records carry one opaque FixedInputData field; MIDDLE_FIXED records carry DataBeforeCtrData and DataAfterCtrData instead. FixedInputData is not split into label/separator/context/[L], so the file does not exercise any particular label/context layout. KO is the leftmost L bits of the iteration output.

unsupported_prfs.reason: out of scope for this model (AES-CMAC and TDES-CMAC PRFs, HMAC over a hash other than SHA-256); no model exists here, so these records are not run
